title: Shell Settings — settings-app UI primitives
description: Portable, brand-free settings-app UI primitives: SettingsSection (titled group with rule), SettingsRow (label left / control right, stacks on narrow widths), Segmented (single-select control on shadcn ToggleGroup), AccentSwatches (color-dot picker), and the composed AppearancePanel (Appearance / Shell / Display groups). Everything the panel shows comes from an injected AppearanceAdapter — all groups optional — so the consumer builds the adapter from its OWN appearance store and option lists; this slice holds no project-specific values. SELF-CONTAINED: imports only shadcn ui + lib/utils.

scenarios.title: Full adapter
scenarios.description: Style/Mode/Accent/Wallpaper + reduce-transparency + Display device override, all live

scenarios.title: Minimal adapter
scenarios.description: Only style + theme provided — the other groups simply don't render

previews.seed: fully offline — an in-preview useState adapter; the consumer injects its real appearance store
